'''Brun''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] prisoner who worked as the cargo crew boss of the night shift at the [[Slashtown]] Prison Colony guard compound on [[Despayre]].

==Biography==
Brun had been incarcerated for several crimes, including [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]], specializing in stripping and then reselling electronics from captured ships. After having been on Despayre for many years, he managed to work his way up into a position of trust with the dirtside guards. Using his position, Brun assisted a fellow prisoner, [[Celot Ratua Dil]], escape Despayre.
